videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video subtitle in Korean, within approximately 500 characters, using 3-5 sentences. The video is about the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections.
Key points from the subtitle:
1. On June 3, during the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections, there was a shortage of ballot papers in some regions, causing inconvenience to citizens and damaging trust in the election management.
2. The Central Election Management Commission Chairman expressed deep responsibility and announced resignation, acknowledging the infringement on voting rights.
3. They will establish a fact-finding committee with external experts to investigate the root cause.
4. According to the Election Policy Director: Out of 14,288 polling stations nationwide, 67 needed additional ballots sent. Actually 50 stations ran out (14 in Songpa-gu, Seoul), and 22 stations temporarily stopped voting.
5. The reason for printing only 50% of the number of eligible voters instead of 100%: Early voting rates have been increasing, leaving excess ballots in high early-voting areas, and considering the collection/storage/disposal process...
So the summary should cover:
The incident: Ballot shortage during June 3 local elections
The cause: Printed only 50% of eligible voters based on early voting trends
The impact: Voting stopped at 22 stations, 50 stations actually ran out
The response: Chairman resigned, fact-finding committee to be formed
